name: frotzscreen
description: frotz(6) full-screen layout: Book and Volume's status window stays FIXED at the top while the lower window scrolls.  Begins a session (B) and looks, and does NOT quit, so the frame-cap capture is the LIVE game screen.  The status window carries the location ('Home') and the game clock ('Sunday 9:07 pm'; the minutes follow the input's timing, so only the day is asserted); frotzscreen_check.py additionally requires row 0 to render as a reverse-video bar against a normal text row.
